title: Earthly Dutch Pandan Skewers
description: A solo dinner dish featuring pandan leaf, with a winey and creamy flavor, cooked to an al-dente finish on a robata grill, suitable for a satvik friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium high heat.
Cut the tofu into 1 inch cubes and thread onto the bamboo skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together the white wine, vegetable oil, garlic, and ginger.
Brush the wine mixture onto the tofu skewers.
Wrap each skewer with a pandan leaf, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pandan leaves are charred and the tofu is cooked through.
In a small saucepan, heat the cream over low heat until warmed through.
Season the cream with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the grilled skewers with the warm cream sauce spooned over the top.
